algorithm: Random Forest (tuned via Optuna), selected by 5-fold CV in Section 7
known_limitations: Demand on stockout-flagged days is censored (understated); model error is expected to be higher on these days and this should not be read as general underperformance.
Model trained on one calendar year (2024) of simulated data; does not yet span multiple years, so year-over-year trend effects are not learned.
Global model shares parameters across all 20 medicines; a very new medicine with no lag history cannot yet be forecast by this version.
retraining_recommendation: Retrain monthly as new dispensing data accumulates, or immediately if MAE on live data drifts more than 20% above this test MAE.
